title: detach_as_character
description: Detaches an attachment from the character it is attached to and turns it into a character in play, ready, at home, under the control of its controller: a character played as an attachment (Promising Youth, when the character it is attached to leaves play), or an attachment (Togashi Hoshi: its skills are its printed modifiers, which the players declare). The cards can belong to any player: the engine does not apply card effects.

card_id.description: Attachment attached to a character in play, or a character played as an attachment.
